# pubrules.api's surface, which tests/features/api.feature holds it to.
# One line per name in pubrules.api.__all__, sorted: "NAME: SHAPE", where SHAPE is
#   function(SIGNATURE)                     a function, as inspect.signature prints it
#   class(BASES) __init__(...); method(...)  a class: its bases, __init__ and public methods
#   pattern 'TEXT' flags=N                  a compiled regex: its text and int(flags)
#   constant VALUE                          a str, int, float or bool, as repr prints it
#   type REPR                               anything else, such as a type alias
# version is recorded as "str, the installed version", with no value: it moves every release.
# When the suite fails here, the lines after "+" in its diff are the ones to write.
ANY_OWNER: constant '(?P<owner>[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*)/'
AT: constant '(?:v|(?P<commit>[0-9a-f]{40})[ \\t]+#[ \\t]*v)'
Api: type collections.abc.Callable[[str, str, typing.Any], typing.Any]
ApiError: class(Exception) __init__(self, message: 'str', response: 'str' = '')
HOSTING_SEP: constant 257
PUBREL_VERSION_INPUT: pattern '(pubrel-version:\\s*v)(?P<version>[0-9][^\\s,}\'\\"]*)' flags=32
PUBRULES_LOCK_PIN: pattern '(?:(?<=^pubrules==)|(?<=/download/v))([0-9][^/\\s\\\\]*)(?=/pubrules-|[\\s\\\\]|$)' flags=40
RELEASE_PIN: pattern '(?P<owner>[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*)/(?P<path>pubrel/\\.github/workflows/release\\.yml@)(?:v|(?P<commit>[0-9a-f]{40})[ \\t]+#[ \\t]*v)(?P<version>[0-9][^\\s\'\\"]*)' flags=32
VARIABLES_BLOCK: constant 'variables'
VERSION: constant '(?P<version>[0-9][^\\s\'\\"]*)'
confined: function(path: 'Path | str', what: 'str', also: 'tuple[Path, ...]' = ()) -> 'Path'
conform: function(root: 'Path', config: 'dict') -> 'tuple[list[str], list[str]]'
dnskey: function(text: 'Any') -> 'tuple[int, int, int, bytes] | None'
gh: function(method: 'str', path: 'str', body: 'Any' = None) -> 'Any'
gh_set: function(kind: 'str', name: 'str', repo: 'str', value: 'str', environment: 'str | None' = None) -> 'str | None'
hosting_settings: function(config: 'dict[str, Any]') -> 'dict[str, Any]'
on_default_branch: function(rs: 'dict') -> 'bool'
on_release_tags: function(rs: 'dict') -> 'bool'
pinned_pubrules: function(repo: 'Path') -> 'str | None'
protection_entry: function(repo: 'str', config: 'Any', where: 'str') -> 'dict'
read_repos: function(path: 'Path', command: 'str') -> 'list[dict]'
remote_config: function(api: 'Api', repo: 'str') -> 'Any'
remote_protection_entry: function(api: 'Api', repo: 'str') -> 'dict'
repo_entries: function(text: 'str | bytes', where: 'str') -> 'list[dict]'
ruleset: function(checks: 'list[str]', queue: 'bool' = True) -> 'dict'
ruleset_differences: function(want: 'dict', have: 'dict') -> 'list[str]'
tag_ruleset: function(release_app: 'int | None' = None) -> 'dict'
variable_defaults: function(block: 'dict') -> 'dict[str, Any]'
variable_name_problem: function(name: 'Any') -> 'str | None'
variables_problems: function(block: 'Any') -> 'list[str]'
version: str, the installed version
